sourceHashMethod.sources: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source after CRLF-to-LF normalization
sourceHashMethod..cache/m6-bench-client: SHA-256 of actual compiled bundle bytes without normalization

method.sourceWarmup: same selected assets; HTTP only; separately recorded for every cell
method.warmTarget: same context after successful read, independent verification and reload
method.limits: production 2 peer transfers and 4 media downloads unchanged; no added pacing

limitations: One local descriptive run; not a capacity guarantee or an EC2/S3 cost estimate.
Independent Chromium processes on one host; synthetic PNGs, fake Redis and local object storage.
HTTP response-body bytes and WebSocket application-payload bytes exclude headers, TLS, TCP, websocket framing and ping/pong.
Server response duration runs from the measurement middleware to the final ASGI body send; it is not browser network latency or TTFB.
Bootstrap phases measure explicit metadata boot after the HTML/JS entry has loaded; initial static page resources are excluded.
DataChannel file payload and 8-byte frame headers are separate; sender and receiver are not added as unique transferred bytes.
No TURN, public STUN, real Cognito, real S3, physical Android, OCR or poster lookup in this browser matrix.
Media latency ends at verified cache availability, not image paint. P50/P95 describe successful tasks; failure counts remain explicit.
Production diagnostic records are supplementary; native transport and all task samples are independently bounded and retained. Missing peer diagnostics make derived diagnostic totals null, not zero.
